settings.heading: From a Home Kitchen to Yours
settings.text: FoodCraft Pro started in 2018 with three sauces, a farmers-market table, and a simple belief: pantry staples should taste like they were made by someone who cares. Today we're still small-batch, still stubborn about ingredients, and still cooking everything ourselves.

settings.heading: Sustainably Sourced
settings.text: We partner with growers who share our commitment to regenerative farming.

settings.heading: Small-Batch Crafted
settings.text: Every batch is cooked, tasted, and packed by our own kitchen team — never outsourced.

settings.heading: No Shortcuts
settings.text: Real ingredients, honest labels, and recipes worth putting your name on.

settings.heading: Small Batches, Big Flavor
settings.text: Every jar is cooked in small batches of no more than 40 at a time, so we can taste-test as we go and never cut corners. It's slower — but it's worth it.

settings.name: Alex Rivera
settings.bio: Trained in Lyon, cooking at home since childhood.

settings.name: Jamie Chen
settings.bio: Finds the farms and mills behind every ingredient.

settings.name: Sofia Novak
settings.bio: Writes and tests every recipe on our blog.

settings.text: You can taste the difference small batches make. This is the real deal.
